text: The Goodyear Tire & Rubber Company is Nasdaq-listed and widely held: its 2026 proxy statement lists the only reported beneficial owners of more than 5% of its common stock as BlackRock (11.5%), The Vanguard Group (10.2%), Wellington Management (8.8%) and Dimensional Fund Advisors (5.8%); no state or state fund is named.
short: Goodyear is stock-exchange listed; its largest reported owners are BlackRock, Vanguard, Wellington and Dimensional.

source.name: The Goodyear Tire & Rubber Company: 2026 definitive proxy statement (Schedule 14A, filed 6 March 2026, SEC EDGAR)
source.quote: The persons identified in the table below have reported that they beneficially owned more than 5% of the outstanding shares of the Common Stock as follows
source.note: The table that follows lists BlackRock, Inc. 32,825,572 shares (11.5%); The Vanguard Group, Inc. 29,095,385 (10.2%); Wellington Management Group LLP 25,253,689 (8.8%); Dimensional Fund Advisors LP 16,501,512 (5.8%).
